frozen_rule: Egg and pupa progress if alive. Larval stage time accrues only after tissue requirement. At exact stage duration update to next ordinal on same ID and reset progress.
measured_endpoint: Egg, larval, combined prepupal/pupal and total days, with temperature and population; colony diet and tracer outcomes First observed worker day 62.88 ± 2.52 SD in 17 worker-producing foundresses at 21 C.
accepted_gap: At 17 C larvae entered diapause in B06. The model has invariant stage settings and a discontinuous tissue gate. Diet affects cohort outcomes; neither cohort growth nor non-target isotope enrichment identifies a threshold. Table 1 detects diet and time-by-diet effects on repeated worker counts in both species. Table S3 detects a diet effect on census 8 minus census 2 only in L. niger and a feeding-frequency effect in both species. These colony endpoints do not establish an individual nutrient rule.

frozen_rule: Larval instars, molts, prepupa and post-emergence maturation have no distinct executable states. Funded reproduction initializes worker eggs. Male and queen may be explicitly seeded as castes.
measured_endpoint: Prepupal and cocoon interval, callow or age-marked worker conditions, and sexual cohort investment
accepted_gap: The stage enum lacks prepupa, instars, molts, callow maturation and reproductive development. B06 pooled two observed stages for measurement. The worker-only funded birth path is not caste determination.

frozen_rule: At fixed cadence synchronize maternal state. Require crop protein at least egg cost and strict water and energy surplus after egg plus maintenance. Integrated ongoing care is interrupted only on a funded birth.
measured_endpoint: Egg-count trajectories with larvae by founding stage, cohort productivity under diet and postmating tissue remodeling All 240 observed endpoints retained in the descriptive check. The weekly-cricket treatment is an offered diet.
accepted_gap: No age/stage-dependent larval feedback or internally remobilized protein pool. Discrete cadence and strict reserve minima are not measured. The maintenance horizon has no direct empirical value.

frozen_rule: Subtract egg protein and water, export egg energy and record separate reproductive dissipation. Copy mother's physiology coefficients to child and set adult protein target to zero.
measured_endpoint: Sexual cohort energetic investment, caste-specific adult oxygen flux and stage days
accepted_gap: Identity is preserved and debits are real. Whole queen investment is not per-egg allocation. Copying maternal coefficients and zeroing juvenile adult protein demand do not have direct support.

frozen_rule: Outside solid is Void. Immutable rock takes precedence. Newest covering edit determines Void for excavation or Soil for fill. Otherwise seed voids then soil.
measured_endpoint: No biological endpoint for solid representation.
accepted_gap: Box precedence and exact ledgers specify representation. They cannot stand in for architecture, material mechanics or ant cognition.

frozen_rule: Continuous clearance checks surface intersections and a swept physical box against solid cells. Legacy geometry requires quantized endpoints and a conservative swept bounding box. Food or soil custody selects larger body half extent.
measured_endpoint: No biological endpoint for sweep or host route.
accepted_gap: World A* and portal metadata are host diagnostics, not an ant perception channel. Static load clearance is a coarse body model.

frozen_rule: Require work duration, local reach, no rock and positive excavatable volume. Reject loaded or over-capacity worker and inadequate loaded clearance. If physiology is enabled require energy strictly above cost.
measured_endpoint: Group excavated volume and substrate-dependent shape. Individual pellet handling observed separately.
accepted_gap: No direct measurement of the uniform geometry reach, cuboid patch, assigned work duration or energy debit. Exact lookup is not a tactile sensory measurement.

frozen_rule: Drop releases at current location, pickup requires reachable deposited parcel and capacity. Fill requires matching held parcel, reachable no-rock void and no encased ant, food or nest anchor.
measured_endpoint: Pellet pickup/deposition rates by pile contact and CT-inferred refilled volumes.
accepted_gap: Explicit Pickup/Fill availability is separate from the autonomous Dig/Move/Drop/Rest path. No pile mechanics or endogenous refill behavior.

frozen_rule: First activation requires depot. Choose reachable frontier uniformly when away and unloaded. Otherwise move through clear local face edges maximizing Manhattan distance from depot, or backtrack at path capacity. Loaded worker follows previous waypoints and drops at path origin.
measured_endpoint: Group shape transition and excavation activity, pellet handling and cross-species participation.
accepted_gap: No basis for uniform frontier picks, Manhattan distance maximization, trace capacity or depot unloading policy. Physical connected void creation does not establish biological shape emergence.

frozen_rule: Require at least two sampled contacts. Count connected sites within Manhattan reach using six face neighbors until contact count multiplied by configured empty-site target is reached.
measured_endpoint: Final group volume, excavation reactivation, area-perimeter transition and temperature-specific CT geometry.
accepted_gap: Two sampled contacts, four sites per contact and chosen Manhattan radius are not measured stimuli. Nest size and worker distribution are not independently identified by that count.

frozen_rule: Compute capped signed distances at regular quantized samples. Only overlapping existing bricks are marked dirty on material edit, and dirty samples are excluded from valid current reads.
measured_endpoint: No biological endpoint for a derived cache.
accepted_gap: Brick dimensions, sample offsets and halo are representation details.

frozen_rule: No temperature, pore or humidity transport, rain/flood, variable particle size, soil rheology, evaporative substrate dynamics, light or endogenous seasonal physiology.
measured_endpoint: Excavated shape by substrate, column temperature and CT, texture locomotion, cold tolerance, field occupancy and drought survival.
accepted_gap: Care metadata and a fixed dry/water mass pair are not temperature, humidity, seasonal dormancy, pore transport or substrate behavior.

frozen_rule: Source/nest/crop/body quantities and consumed sinks are distinct. Endogenous birth initial state is linked by mother and not counted again as external input. Inert other material occupies storage capacity.
measured_endpoint: Queen flight-muscle and adipocyte histology by day, dry sexual body combustion energy, worker body composition
accepted_gap: Ledger preserves source, crop, tissue and losses but has no flight-muscle or lipid reserve accessible for founding. No conversion of histology or combustion energy into initial usable body stores. FT01-X illustrates three collection-to-fixation intervals in P. crassinoda and cannot supply a L. niger rate.

frozen_rule: Reject invalid/dead/unreachable recipient, disabled exchange, no room or supply. Demand-sensitive mode intersects donor crop and recipient ingredient deficit. Transfer proportional bounded integer composition between crops.
measured_endpoint: Directed oral contacts, seconds per worker bout, and observed regurgitation to queens and larvae
accepted_gap: An ordinary event atomically moves compatible crop components. Physical oral contact duration, solicitation and acceptance, composition and dose were not measured together for the simulated recipient castes and stages.

frozen_rule: Queen adult_protein_target_ug can make stored crop protein eligible for provision. No separate weighted queen recipient priority. Adult received protein remains crop stock available to funded egg allocation or transfer.
measured_endpoint: Observed worker regurgitation to queens, care under hand feeding, and foundress productivity under offered diets All 240 observed endpoints retained in the descriptive check. The weekly-cricket treatment is an offered diet.
accepted_gap: Worker-to-queen supply is possible. Neither relative selection of mother vs larva, queen crop protein target nor dose is measured by the used endpoints. B01 feeding addresses care, not worker-to-queen flux.

frozen_rule: Initialize all compartments, first absorption clock and owned physiology event. Long intervals, alternate water clock and queen-specific adult crop target require long-term contract.
measured_endpoint: Foundress tissue remodeling, adult/pool mass and oxygen flux; sexual whole-body combustion energy
accepted_gap: Explicit initialized stores and a first wake are computational, not a mass/age/temperature mapping. Endogenous histolysis and stage-specific usable reserves are missing. Role classification does not supply an exact worker age. Rearing 25 C/50–60% RH is separate from the 20 C oxygen assay. FT01-X illustrates three collection-to-fixation intervals in P. crassinoda and cannot supply a L. niger rate.

frozen_rule: Apply basal_nj_per_ms for every live stage and add active_nj_per_ms for an Adult in Nurse, Forage or Excavate. Debit min(current energy, rate * elapsed) and count dissipation.
measured_endpoint: Rest-context oxygen flux per queen or worker estimate, mass-normalized rate and developing sexual respiration
accepted_gap: Caste and life stage differ experimentally. The fixture basal and task premium do not follow from oxygen measurements. A program label, including waiting, is not measured movement or loaded work. Role classification does not supply an exact worker age. Rearing 25 C/50–60% RH is separate from the 20 C oxygen assay.

frozen_rule: Convert eligible crop carbohydrate by fixed nJ per ug and store water. Only larvae move crop protein into tissue up to the larval requirement. Eggs/pupae advance the absorption clock without substrate transfer.
measured_endpoint: Dry tissue combustion energy, whole colony dietary response, and non-target tracer enrichment
accepted_gap: Fixed pulse, rate, energy yield and larval-only protein assimilation are a simple mass/energy budget. Oxygen and whole dry-body energy cannot identify usable crop carbohydrate yield or absorption timing. Table 1 detects diet and time-by-diet effects on repeated worker counts in both species. Table S3 detects a diet effect on census 8 minus census 2 only in L. niger and a feeding-frequency effect in both species. These colony endpoints do not establish an individual nutrient rule.

frozen_rule: Accumulate integer water loss with remainder and debit at most current hydration. Crop water can replenish hydration at Adult/Larva absorption pulses.
measured_endpoint: Access to water under foundress care and thermal rearing conditions. No caste-specific loss flux in these measurements. First observed worker day 62.88 ± 2.52 SD in 17 worker-producing foundresses at 21 C.
accepted_gap: The constant water clock, integer storage and depletion threshold have no RH, temperature or evaporation law. Water availability does not determine individual water mass or uptake rates.

frozen_rule: Parameter values can differ by externally selected individual fixture. No caste or ontogenetic scaling function, dynamic temperature development response, respiration or diapause.
measured_endpoint: Distinct oxygen estimates by caste, stage-specific oxygen flux and geographic thermal development curves
accepted_gap: Caste/size and temperature do not drive the simulated rates. A correlation with adult mass or a thermal stage table does not authorize a universal multiplier. Role classification does not supply an exact worker age. Rearing 25 C/50–60% RH is separate from the 20 C oxygen assay.

frozen_rule: At time zero before execution, create a LasiusNigerEngineeringFixture colony and valid living-stage ant rows. Allocate world-qualified monotonic IDs and record the starting stage, born_at and carrying capacity.
measured_endpoint: No biological endpoint for identifier registration.
accepted_gap: Founding process and colony size distribution require a separately declared experimental population. Seeding must be excluded from natural birth counts.

frozen_rule: Accept next ordinal live stage only for an unphysiologized individual, or forced death. Reject a skipped stage or repeated death. Interrupt care on a stage change.
measured_endpoint: No biological endpoint; software mechanism
accepted_gap: An externally injected next stage or death is an experimental intervention. It supplies no natural transition hazard or duration.

frozen_rule: Living count changes only on seeding, funded births or death. Stage/identity history is preserved. No colony-level birth quota or death-triggered global behavior branch.
measured_endpoint: Founding productivity, colony worker census, queenless ovary activation and winter worker survival.
accepted_gap: Living metadata includes all live ant stages. Experimental worker census differs. No colony-level failure rule, replacement queen or worker male reproduction from queen loss.

frozen_rule: A zero energy or water store commits Dead. Energy wins the cause label when both are zero. Clear owned physiology, nutrition, reproduction, foraging, excavation, care and autonomy work.
measured_endpoint: Survival and brood emergence under controlled founding, with water and temperature treatments in different studies First observed worker day 62.88 ± 2.52 SD in 17 worker-producing foundresses at 21 C.
accepted_gap: Zero energy/hydration kills all modeled stages and simultaneous depletion has deterministic precedence. Mortality cause, biological tolerance and aging are unresolved; broader mortality is deferred.

frozen_rule: Only measured-in-engine reserve exhaustion or external fixture death changes life state to Dead. born_at is identity history and can be used as care context metadata.
measured_endpoint: Adult age-at-death, dietary survival, acute thermal tolerance, desiccation and overwintering outcomes.
accepted_gap: No age, exposure, injury, pathogen, thermal or sex-specific hazard beyond the current reserve/fixture path. Available studies do not identify stage-specific death risks for all juveniles.

frozen_rule: Release componentwise min of remaining reserve and scaled pulse limits. Optional low productivity applies on odd productive spans. Continue scheduling even if the released amount is zero.
measured_endpoint: Artificial diet input, colony development, deprivation responsiveness and endogenous dormancy.
accepted_gap: Absolute-time alternating scale, fixed composition and depletion are an external treatment generator. No prey, aphid renewal or seasonal production feedback.

frozen_rule: Legacy locate requires a cell center within numeric tolerance. Continuous motion uses a tile only as an index and checks the traversed tiles, including corner and border coverage.
measured_endpoint: Not applicable to grid coordinates or swept clearance
accepted_gap: A walkable tile does not imply that a worker knows the tile or its geometry. Surface resolution, cubic clearance and corner logic represent the world motor.

frozen_rule: There is no receptor, image, light, vibrational or multimodal noisy perception path. Contact, distance and clearance are direct software predicates.
measured_endpoint: Track shape under changed light, substrate speed, room effect, controlled contact-to-fork direction null
accepted_gap: There is no visual or other receptor model here. Peer or brood contact elsewhere in Core does not feed this foraging decision. The paper outcomes do not imply global resource coordinates.

frozen_rule: Reject concurrent dedicated care or externally owned resolution as applicable. Mark enrollment and enqueue at the social decision interval only for adults.
measured_endpoint: No biological endpoint for enrollment.
accepted_gap: The first scheduled wake cannot identify age, motivation or natural onset. B3-C02 concerns measured task heterogeneity.

frozen_rule: Urgency plus usable stock selects Rest. Optional continuation holds Nurse if a sampled recipient can use carried nutrition. Otherwise draw weighted Rest, Forage, social Nurse, Excavate or care lease from private seed.
measured_endpoint: Task act distributions, scout/nestmate interactions and food-specific recruitment fractions.
accepted_gap: Fixed weights, reserve quarter-cutoff, two Nurse options and numerical contact sample are not observed choices. Clock, intake and geometry alter the eligible denominator.

frozen_rule: Cancel previously owned nutrition, foraging or excavation work and activate the selected program. Long-term return can replace wake with a next-millisecond policy wake favoring Rest.
measured_endpoint: Observed act counts, aggregation fractions/site occupancy and qualitative dormancy.
accepted_gap: Rest can invoke nutrition and basal metabolism. Nurse, Forage and Excavate may accrue active debit while waiting. Rested and program time lack a sleep or inactivity-bout definition.

frozen_rule: No explicit age-dependent transition probabilities, specialist worker morphs, individual fatigue state or social reinforcement network for allocation.
measured_endpoint: Marked-worker task counts, head width, group transfer latency and age-by-role molecular profiles.
accepted_gap: No measured fatigue recovery or age-specific transition law. Private random draws and assigned caste do not implement a stable worker phenotype.

frozen_rule: Seed call before execution | Valid caste/stage, referenced colony, world bounds and body clearance | New identity plus AntSeeded fact, contact index and living count
measured_endpoint: No biological endpoint for seeding.
accepted_gap: A seeded late-stage ant cannot be counted as a naturally surviving egg or a new worker from the queen.

frozen_rule: Externally scheduled fixture lifecycle event. Only next ordinal for nonphysiological development. Death allowed. Repeated death rejected. Commit stage or death on same ID. Release care ownership and stop dead individual's scheduled programs
measured_endpoint: No biological endpoint; software mechanism
accepted_gap: The accepted or rejected fixture transition is determined by host scheduling and ordinal guards, not empirical stage timing.

frozen_rule: Explicit initialization at unexecuted time zero. Valid seed and configuration. Reject fixture development conflicts and invalid long-term settings. Initialize crop/body/hydration/tissue and schedule earliest physiological boundary
measured_endpoint: No biological endpoint; software mechanism
accepted_gap: A setup enrollment and its validation bounds are software preconditions. Study-specific masses do not initialize the model's reserve state.

frozen_rule: Elapsed simulated time since last update. All live stages basal. Only Adult Forage/Nurse/Excavate adds activity. Dead returns. Debit clamped rate * elapsed and accumulate dissipation
measured_endpoint: Rest-context and stage-specific oxygen consumption
accepted_gap: Adding a fixed premium for program residence differs from measuring incremental cost during a moving or loaded bout. The shared coefficients omit stage-specific response. Role classification does not supply an exact worker age. Rearing 25 C/50–60% RH is separate from the 20 C oxygen assay.

frozen_rule: Elapsed time and fixed loss period. Bound lost mass by stores. Use integer quotient/remainder. Update hydration and lost water
measured_endpoint: Water-provisioned founding outcomes, not individual water loss
accepted_gap: Fixed linear loss with an integer remainder is a budget rule. No evaporative or absorption flux was observed in those trials.

frozen_rule: Physiology event reaches next_absorption after priority checks. Adult/Larva only for carbs/water. Larva only for tissue protein. Bound by crop, room and rate. Consume crop, credit actual internal stores and schedule next pulse
measured_endpoint: Oxygen/combustion data, diet-dependent growth and non-target isotope enrichment
accepted_gap: Neither scheduled absorption nor absence of egg/pupal substrate use through the crop is quantified by these endpoints. Oxygen use demonstrates metabolism rather than crop assimilation. Table 1 detects diet and time-by-diet effects on repeated worker counts in both species. Table S3 detects a diet effect on census 8 minus census 2 only in L. niger and a feeding-frequency effect in both species. These colony endpoints do not establish an individual nutrient rule.

frozen_rule: Physiology advances or protein assimilation makes gate true. Gate uses tissue, not crop mass. Always settle maintenance and water. Accrue developmental time only once tissue threshold holds
measured_endpoint: Temperature-dependent diapause in first brood; diet-dependent growth; non-target tracer enrichment
accepted_gap: The model stops stage-time accumulation at a single protein threshold. A cohort development delay or pooled tracer cannot identify that threshold or substitute for temperature-driven diapause. Table 1 detects diet and time-by-diet effects on repeated worker counts in both species. Table S3 detects a diet effect on census 8 minus census 2 only in L. niger and a feeding-frequency effect in both species. These colony endpoints do not establish an individual nutrient rule.

frozen_rule: Owned wake at exact stage duration. Alive with both stores positive. Larval clock requires adequate tissue. Commit next ordinal on same AntId and reset stage clock. Schedule eligible adulthood autonomy and next physiology
measured_endpoint: Egg days and actual rearing temperature by population, Table 2
accepted_gap: Egg-to-larva endpoint is a candidate future comparison when temperature and population are matched. Fixed source duration does not capture the observed response.

frozen_rule: Owned wake at exact stage duration. Alive with both stores positive. Larval clock requires adequate tissue. Commit next ordinal on same AntId and reset stage clock. Schedule eligible adulthood autonomy and next physiology
measured_endpoint: Hatch to cocoon formation days and diapause outcomes
accepted_gap: Source age is gated by tissue and ends at model pupation. Laboratory larval time includes all intervening nutrition and is not measured from tissue threshold crossing.

frozen_rule: Owned wake at exact stage duration. Alive with both stores positive. Larval clock requires adequate tissue. Commit next ordinal on same AntId and reset stage clock. Schedule eligible adulthood autonomy and next physiology
measured_endpoint: Cocoon/prepupal interval to emergence and sexual pupal respiration
accepted_gap: The closest timing observation pools prepupa and pupa. There is no measured mapping to a standalone model Pupa timer or inferred stage-specific energy cost.

frozen_rule: Settled energy or hydration reaches zero. EnergyDepleted wins when both zero. Death checked before assimilation or development. Record death, decrement living count, remove contact and stop owned programs
measured_endpoint: Foundress and first-brood viability across assays
accepted_gap: The exact zero-store death boundary, energy/water precedence and death before assimilation at equal time are not observed biological thresholds.

frozen_rule: Biological threshold death or manual fixture death. Cancel reproduction and care even before the physiology component check. Clear physiology/behavior events and set Paused on retained physiology row
measured_endpoint: No biological endpoint; software mechanism
accepted_gap: Fixture death and exact software depletion labels determine cancellation. They do not identify a cause for a dead laboratory ant.

frozen_rule: Resolved donor-recipient action. Living Adult/Larva, same-colony contact and geometry, exchange enabled, nonempty compatible supply and recipient capacity. Debit donor crop and credit recipient crop with actual amount and Success/Partial
measured_endpoint: Worker oral contact durations/counts and documented larva or queen recipient
accepted_gap: No matching simultaneous outcome for recipient acceptance, component mass, rejected proposals, castes and duration. Distinguish observation of oral exchange from one atomic transfer.

frozen_rule: Explicit enable or funded birth | Alive admissible caste and physiology, social enabled and no incompatible action ownership | Record enrollment. First adult wake is after social interval.
measured_endpoint: No biological endpoint.
accepted_gap: No age-specific onset probability or juvenile task learning is observed by scheduling.

frozen_rule: Explicit disable | Dedicated care policy differs from integrated lease | Interrupt integrated lease, cancel policy wake and record change
measured_endpoint: No biological endpoint.
accepted_gap: Manual disable is an intervention rather than a spontaneous change of motivation.

frozen_rule: Adult activation / terminal life transition | Enabled adult with no existing wake / registered autonomous state | Schedule one decision or cancel and deactivate
measured_endpoint: No biological endpoint.
accepted_gap: Emergence need not coincide with immediate mature task propensity. A cleared wake does not model mortality.

frozen_rule: Policy wake | Return marker in long-term mode, urgent compatible depot stock, or active Nurse with exchange and compatible carried nutrients | Apply actual program change only when selection differs
measured_endpoint: Food-type and deprivation effects, and queen care response.
accepted_gap: No observed threshold or rule for forced Rest, nutrient-vector access or donation continuation.

frozen_rule: Policy wake after dwell or when paused | Positive weight and task-specific local eligibility | Use actor-private weighted draw, batch choices then commit in actor order
measured_endpoint: Task events, body-size associations, transfer efficiency and food-response contrasts.
accepted_gap: Study denominators are group or assay-specific. None measures relative draw weights, the same Nurse label for two motors, or exact dwell.

frozen_rule: Committed return callback | Long-term config and enabled autonomy | Replace ordinary wake with return-marked wake one millisecond later
measured_endpoint: No biological endpoint for priority rescheduling.
accepted_gap: One millisecond is a causality convention, with no natural post-trip latency inference.

frozen_rule: Manual pause or program preemption | Live registered physiological actor. Reject conflicting external work. | Settle to boundary and cancel owned behavioral events. Keep physiology running.
measured_endpoint: No biological endpoint for a manual pause.
accepted_gap: Paused has no sleep, circadian or fatigue measurement.

frozen_rule: Explicit program change or committed local policy choice | Adult Worker with valid configured surface and admissible remembered or initial route | Install forager ownership and its Perception wake
measured_endpoint: Nest exit responses and conditional scout outcomes.
accepted_gap: The starting role, surface requirement and path reuse are the program interface.

frozen_rule: Explicit program change or committed local policy choice | Adult Worker with geometry and valid excavation waypoint history | Activate one owned excavation wake
measured_endpoint: Excavation onset and volume/rate in artificial arenas.
accepted_gap: Exact waypoint history and queue installation do not measure adoption of a digger role.

frozen_rule: Explicit program change, local policy choice or finite care lease | Living Adult Worker. Care motor suppresses the ordinary nutrition wake. | Schedule ordinary NutritionWake for Rest/Nurse or allow timed care to own the motor. Record actual role change.
measured_endpoint: Brood care act frequency and aggregation observations.
accepted_gap: Rest/Nurse task assignment is coarser than acts. Motor lease suppresses a nutrition scheduler for software ownership.

frozen_rule: Setup enrollment. Physiological Adult Queen with social and long-term config at time zero. Record activation and schedule interval
measured_endpoint: No biological endpoint; software mechanism
accepted_gap: Adult Queen enrollment and fixture flags control entry. A scheduled attempt does not correspond to first mating, first oviposition or ovarian maturation.

frozen_rule: Reproduction wake. Requires exact funded body and crop reserves and local clearance. Defer unchanged or interrupt owned care, debit maternal costs and create one Egg. Rearm.

frozen_rule: Physiological or explicit lifecycle death. Registered reproduction exists. Cancel wake
measured_endpoint: No biological endpoint; software mechanism
accepted_gap: Death cancels a pending owned attempt. Evidence on aging, diapause or reversible infertility is not represented by cancellation.

frozen_rule: Successful birth transaction. Single entity allocation and nutrient budget checks. Retain stable ID, parent, indexed position, physiology, lifecycle and canonical birth facts
measured_endpoint: Sexual energetic investment, distinct caste oxygen use and immature stage times
accepted_gap: Single allocation at mother's location and copying rates preserve identity and conservation. No comparable per-egg allocation or lineage-dependent rate map was identified.
